title: Product completion after 957-file full audit
businessRules: The post-audit workflow docs/TOKO360-MASTER-PRODUCT-COMPLETION-WORKFLOW.md is authoritative for new product-completion work; historical R0-R8 recovery remains evidence only.
No capability can close from route/button/source-marker existence alone.
Every visible contextual navigation item must map to semantically isolated operator content.
Critical/high functional work requires runtime mutation evidence; UI completion additionally requires human visual acceptance.
Foundation/baseline/adapter-ready capabilities must not be presented as production-complete.
Human Stage-20 cannot be replaced by automated browser tests.
Ubuntu Bash is the canonical operator/developer command surface.
Tax-affecting fixes must preserve effective-dated/versioned tax semantics and historical period correctness; no retroactive mutation of used tax versions.

P1 source isolation must preserve the canonical contextual route map (62/62 after splitting Customer from Category/Subcategory); P1 cannot close until browser route-heading evidence, screenshots, and human IA acceptance pass.
Browser UAT critical Admin journeys must resolve through config/admin-contextual-workflow-map.json and stable Admin workspace/view semantics; legacy hard-coded workspace ownership is forbidden.

P2A transaction UOM authority is ProductUnit at order/sale creation; persisted transaction snapshots are immutable historical authority for fulfillment, return and refund, so current ProductUnit changes must never reinterpret old transactions.

OrderItem.quantity and return-item quantity remain canonical integer base-unit quantities for inventory/batch/serial movements; unitQuantity and quantityFactor preserve operator/customer transaction UOM.
Prisma schema-only validate/generate commands must be provider-safe without rewriting the active .env; database-touching commands must still require a real provider-matching protected DATABASE_URL.
P2 is one atomic delivery wave; P2A/P2B are internal implementation streams and must not create separate operator apply/test/commit boundaries.

P2 runtime closure requires both dedicated exact-source PostgreSQL gates: ci:p2a:multi-uom-probe for A-03 and ci:p2:payroll-probe for A-04; migration/source tests or unrelated recovery probes cannot promote either finding to RUNTIME_VERIFIED.

Payroll tax methods GROSS, GROSS_UP and NET are executable supported configuration; valid effective-dated component/profile/rule changes are segmented by actual active dates and must not return REQUIRES_REVIEW solely because they occur inside one payroll period.
Split-period tax/social allocation must use actual temporal component amounts with exact remainder handling; proportional stretching of one period total across statutory segments is forbidden.
acceptanceCriteria: P0-P7 are executed in order without skipping dependency gates.
All A-01 through A-15 audit findings are either closed with evidence or explicitly reclassified with documented rationale.
14 Admin primary workspaces and all retained contextual views render semantically correct isolated workflows.
Master Data exposes Category/Subcategory and Customer as separate operator destinations; Category supports obvious add-root/add-subcategory hierarchy actions.
Multi-UOM order/return/refund lineage is persisted and runtime-verified.
Payroll supported methods and split-period behavior are implemented and runtime-verified or removed from product claims.
Retention/archive, API-key rotation, and session lifecycle have intentional operator ownership.
Admin, POS, Storefront, and Employee Portal pass human visual acceptance after page-level redesign.
Final exact-source runtime simulation and Human Stage-20 both pass before PRODUCT_READY=true.
testPlan: Exact-source PostgreSQL/runtime/browser evidence for every CRITICAL/HIGH wave
Human Stage-20 visual and functional acceptance
Runtime inventory invariant: stock quantity/available/reserved and append-only movement remain consistent across transaction/reversal flows
Runtime accounting invariant: journal entries remain balanced debit=credit and reversal/posting traces remain canonical
Runtime sync invariant: idempotency, retry, offline replay, and conflict handling remain fail-closed where affected
Browser contextual-route contract audit must pass before exact-source Browser UAT and must reject stale capability ownership.

P2A exact-source PostgreSQL runtime: create mixed-UOM storefront order, fulfill it, mutate/deactivate current ProductUnit, then return/refund and prove persisted UOM snapshot, inventory base quantity, tax and accounting reversal remain consistent.

P2A exact-source gate must produce handoff/quality/github-p2a-multi-uom-runtime-probe-latest.json with PASS, matching source fingerprint, productionTouched=false, historical UOM after ProductUnit deactivation, balanced fulfillment/return journals, exact amount remainder, and base-inventory round-trip.
migrationPlan: Use expand-only migrations for new persistence required by functional-completeness fixes. Rehearse PostgreSQL migrations before exact-runtime closure. Never rewrite applied migration history.
rollbackPlan: Rollback one atomic wave at a time to the preceding clean exact-source checkpoint. Schema-changing waves require a documented compatibility/roll-forward strategy; do not use destructive migration rollback against shared data.
monitoringPlan: Each wave records source fingerprint, runtime probe evidence, browser evidence where UI changes, audit status, and human acceptance status. Final product status is rendered from one canonical capability truth source.
securityNotes: Remove tracked credentials immediately, preserve tenant/branch/permission authority, keep runtime probes non-production, sanitize evidence, and never weaken denial/fail-closed gates to obtain green.
verificationGates: P2 Payroll exact-source PostgreSQL runtime: execute GROSS, GROSS_UP and NET in one effective-dated payroll period, prove actual split component/rule allocation, balanced posting, salary settlement, post-payment differential adjustment, employee-receivable recovery and recovery settlement.

P2 full aggregate gate requires both handoff/quality/github-p2a-multi-uom-runtime-probe-latest.json and handoff/quality/github-p2-payroll-runtime-probe-latest.json PASS on matching source fingerprints with productionTouched=false.
